records.model: Use every received coordinate slot in order; mask printed dashes and the literal noncoordinate Q only. No inserted/deleted/moved coordinate.
notes: The received 330 slots include 33 printed dashes and one Q-shaped glyph transcribed Q and conservatively masked at source 154. All slots are retained; there is no insertion or deletion relative to the printed source.
FLIEGERABTL, MARSCHZIEL and the ordinary body are conditional editorial fills, with the exact observed-coordinate costs recorded separately. CRAIOVA is a proposed place reading.
The phrase DAHIEREIGENERPARKERRICHTETWIRD is proposed. The boundary after WIRD remains unknown rather than choosing X orY.
The destination remains literal HK? with unknown final cell domain BCKMSW; it is not silently corrected to OKM. The unit 24 and closing ?3X4OPYY retain their raw labels.

The previous unreviewed OCR candidate stream contained 323 slots, seven fewer than the source, and did not produce this coherent Nov28-key body. Restoring omitted printed slots is source retranscription, not a seven-coordinate repair of the actual source.

prior_credit.published_period_key: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), DOI10.1080/01611194.2016.1169461; algorithmic numeral/rare-letter meanings remain separately uncertain.
prior_credit.prior_body_candidates: A1-A3/B1-B2 were already represented by unreviewed cross-key OCR candidates; A2/A3/B1/B2 are also in the frozen p73 retrieval corpus. These earlier computations are retained, not claimed as new first decryptions.
prior_credit.new_contribution: Visual source transcription, exact header/slot corrections, source-priced ordinary-word editions and the coherent Nov28-key p229 C aviation message recovered from its 330 actual slots.

bounded_published_body_check.scope: The explicit page-reference search and nearby historical sections6.3-6.5 did not identify these p229 bodies. supplementary_readings and the current catalog had no p229 entries. This bounded check is not a universal first-decipherment claim.

interpretation_policy: No optional Nov28 numeral or separator map is applied. Raw labels are preserved, except for the individually priced ordinary-word coordinate repairs. No amount, unit number or unresolved destination is inferred from plausibility.
